newsitem.title: USA: Ek Chor sees no further market weakening.
newsitem.headline: Ek Chor sees no further market weakening.

text.p: Ek Chor China Motorcycle Co Ltd said Thursday it did not expect the motorcycle market in the People's Repubilc of China (PRC) to weaken any more after an oversupply of such vehicles hurt the company's earnings for the year.
"Whilst the overall markets situation for motorcycles is still unsatisfactory, further deterioration is unlikely and we are hopeful of seeing a very gradual improvement in the sector," it said.
The company reported a share profit of $0.20 for 1996 against $1.23 for the previous year.
"The company continues to be advsersely affected by the difficult market conditions in the PRC motorcycle industry, resulting primarily from an oversupply of motorcycles in the market," it said.
It did not provide any sale or revenue figures.

The company is a Bermuda incorporated holding company that holds interests in sino-foreign joint ventures in the People's Repubilc of China. The ventures make motorcycle parts and components, among other things.
